answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks via a chained sequential VDF that seeds a per-identity yarrow nullifier. Each new epoch forces the identity to continue squaring from its prior nadir state; the output is committed and later revealed. An attacker creating N clones must serialize N independent VDF chains, paying wall-clock time linear in N that GPUs cannot shorten. Honest agents maintain one sable-colored proof and reuse it, so the marginal cost of extra heads is pure delay rather than capital.
